 Bruce Buffer recalls UFC brawls and says Dillon Danis should be banned
 Saturday, 14 November 2026, 23:01 
 Photo source: Fox News 
 The longtime UFC ring announcer recalled several fights outside the octagon and said he supports Dillon Danis being banned from UFC. 
 Former UFC bantamweight champion Merab Dvalishvili was jumped last week in a hotel lobby in Abu Dhabi by MMA free agent Usman Nurmagomedov, the younger brother of Dvalishvili’s former opponent Umar Nurmagomedov. Usman Nurmagomedov and his crew were sentenced to six months in prison.
 This is reported by Fox News .
 Buffer, UFC’s ring announcer since 1996, said he has seen many frightening moments. He recalled being at the fight between Khabib Nurmagomedov and Conor McGregor when Khabib jumped over the cage, and said he had witnessed many other brawls during his 31 years in the job. Khabib Nurmagomedov is Usman and Umar’s cousin.
 I was at the Khabib [Nurmagomedov] and Conor McGregor fight when Khabib jumped over the cage. That was a big deal. I’ve also seen other brawls break out. I’ve seen so many; I’ve been doing this for 31 years, 
 - Bruce Buffer
 UFC is scheduled to return to Madison Square Garden on Saturday. The last time the venue hosted fights, Dillon Danis brawled with several members of lightweight champion Islam Makhachev’s team in the stands. The incident led to Danis being banned from UFC, a decision Buffer supports.
 Dylan’s banned. Dylan should be banned. It seems every time Dylan goes somewhere, he causes trouble, so there’s no reason for him to be anywhere near us. I have no problem saying that, 
 - Bruce Buffer
 Buffer also recalled a brawl after UFC 13 in 1997.
 I remember a big brawl in the early days at an after-party. I was talking to Tank Abbott, and all of a sudden I saw Tank get hit across the face with an overhand right. It was Wallid Ismail, and all hell broke loose, 
 - Bruce Buffer
 When I’m in a brawl like that, I get my back to a wall so you only have to worry about who’s in front of you. Everybody’s going at it. Always keep your back protected and know where your exit is. Know where your six is. Just watch. But things happen. 
 - Bruce Buffer
 Buffer said he was “sorry to see” Dvalishvili get fined “because it wasn't his fault.”
